text:
jess_support: Customer reported tool invoke failing with schema validation on Production.
jess_support: customer request id r-0x9a7c, hitting /v1/tools/payments/invoke, error returned 400 validation_error
jess_support: quick paste of API response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  \"error\": {\"code\": \"validation_error\", \"message\": \"JSON schema validation failed\", \"details\": [\"additionalProperties not allowed: 'promoCode'\", \"/args/amount: expected number, got string\"]}
}
```
jess_support: customer says this worked last week; they upgraded SDK -> 2.4.0. payload below (redacted):
```
POST /v1/tools/payments/invoke
{\n  \"billing_profile\": { \"id\": \"acct_123\" },\n  \"args\": { \"amount\": \"1200\", \"currency\": \"USD\", \"promoCode\": \"SPRING\" },\n  \"meta\": { \"source\": \"checkout\" }\n}
```
jess_support: raising to eng, customer on a live checkout flow.
matt_eng: looking - thanks. two obvious things: (1) schema expects amount:number, (2) tool function schema has additionalProperties:false so promoCode is rejected. did they switch SDK behaviour that stopped coercion?
jess_support: they confirmed SDK 1.x coerced numeric strings to numbers; 2.4.0 sends raw types.
matt_eng: ok repro steps request: can someone run an invoke with the posted payload against the validation service and attach logs? I'll try a quick local repro.
olivia_ml: tagging since function routing might select a different function variant if extra props exist. If promoCode present maybe router picks payments-v2 which has stricter schema.
olivia_ml: quick check on model catalog - payments-v2 schema strictness set in infra changelist D-1221.
anna_sre: deploy-bot shows a canary of schema tightening rolled out 2 days ago to prod: deploy-bot: schema-validator@prod 2026-03-15T03:12Z -> changed additionalProperties to false for payments functions.
pm_tom: pm_tom: customer impact note: we need mitigation (rollback or compatibility shim) and comms.
matt_eng: repro log from my local run:
```
$ curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tools/payments/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d @payload.json
{
  \"error\": {
    \"code\": \"validation_error\",
    \"message\": \"additionalProperties not allowed: 'promoCode', /args/amount: expected number, got string\"
  }
}
```
matt_eng: root cause: (A) gateway no longer coerces numeric-looking strings for this route, (B) schema became strict rejecting extras. combined -> customer failure.
jess_support: customer is asking for immediate temporary fix, their checkout is failing for ~1200 users.
anna_sre: mitigation options:
- quick gateway shim to coerce amount strings -> numbers on the payments route (low-risk patch)
- revert schema tightening for payments-v2 (requires deploy, possible regressions)
- add a compatibility layer that strips unknown keys (promoCode) from args before validation
anna_sre: I can push a shim to the edge that normalizes types in ~10m, psuedo-code:
```
if (typeof body.args.amount === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(body.args.amount)) {
  body.args.amount = Number(body.args.amount)
}
if (body.args.promoCode) delete body.args.promoCode
```
pm_tom: customer asked for ETA and preference: they prefer a fast patch to unblock checkout.
matt_eng: agree on quick shim at gateway + a ticket to revert if there are downstream issues. also add unit test to ensure coercion behaviour documented.
olivia_ml: also check function router: we need to ensure promoCode removal doesn't change function selection (promoCode used by experiment routing?)
matt_eng: good point, olivia. I'll run router test matrix with/without promoCode.
anna_sre: I'll open a fast rollback/patch PR and coordinate with deploy-bot. tagging @deploy-bot for a canary rollout plan.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued: schema-validator-shim v0.1 -> canary on payments env -> awaiting manual approval.
matt_eng: acceptance criteria: 1) checkout flows for customer r-0x9a7c succeed with shim, 2) no router variant changes, 3) automated coercion tests added.
jess_support: shared customer repro instructions to eng (they can reproduce with the payload above).
pm_tom: I'll inform account team and draft a short status message for the customer: ETA ~2 hours for a patch canary, 90% likely to unblock.
matt_eng: local test results after shim applied to dev gateway:
```
$ curl -d @payload-coerced.json
{ \"result\": \"invoke accepted\", \"tool_response\": { \"status\": \"ok\", \"charge_id\": \"ch_9b\" } }
```
matt_eng: router tests show same function selection after removing promoCode in 1000 sample requests.
olivia_ml: filed follow-up: D-1302 add feature-flag for coercion and document SDK breaking change. also add migration notes for SDK 2.4.0.
jess_support: customer updated: checkout unblocked in canary, they asked us to keep them posted when fully deployed.
pm_tom: post-mortem actions: roll out shim globally, patch SDK docs, add a compatibility test in CI, and follow up with customer.
jess_support: closing the thread once global deploy done. thanks all :heart:
